description_en: Queries the intelligent alert event recording plan of an IPC device by device ID
description_zh: 调用该接口，根据IPC的设备ID查询智能告警事件录像计划
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual query-event-record-plan-device-by-device --iot-instance-id iot-cn-n6w1y590000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name camera1 --iot-id zLZyi6aOLyOSHa9hsPyD000000 --stream-type 0 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryEventRecordPlanDeviceByDevice

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.

If the public instance does not have an ID value, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console, or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html to query the information about all products under the current account.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the IPC device.
You can view the DeviceName on the Devices page in the IoT Platform console.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的设备页查看DeviceName。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html of IoT Platform to query the device ID.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId is a globally unique identifier of the device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName on a one-to-one basis. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en:
The stream type. Valid values:
0 (default): main stream
1: sub stream
parameters.help_zh:
码流类型：
0（默认）：主码流
1：辅码流
parameters.name: stream_type
